newsitem.title: JAPAN: Drop in Japan spending due to sales tax--agency.
newsitem.headline: Drop in Japan spending due to sales tax--agency.

text.p: A year-on-year drop in Japan's household spending in May was due to negative effects of an increase in the nation's consumption tax on April 1, an official of the government's Management and Coordination Agency said on Thursday.
The agency earlier on Thursday announced that household spending in May fell 2.2 percent in real terms from a year earlier.
"Consumer sentiment was dampened in May and we should not be complacent about it in June," an agency official told reporters.
